rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"In both the property and field loops of TypeCollector.GetObjectInfo, the change stops adding a member to intMembers or stringMembers when that key is already there. It also skips a member with continue right after reporting the DoNotMixStringAndIntKeys diagnostic. Before, a duplicate key reached Dictionary.Add, which can throw. Now the KeysMustBeUnique or mixed-key diagnostic is reported and collection carries on. The fix keeps reporting the problem and stops the crash.
